items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I went to engineering school and got a degree, worked at an insurance company for a while at one point which I didn’t really care for but it was a good experience. Went and got a real estate license in between a cruise with Flip Phillips.

ctx.x: When it came time for a choice of career, was your family supportive?

They were always supportive and they strongly invited and suggested that at least I get a college degree. Well they were looking out for my best interests I’m sure, just for my own edification. And I’m a fairly sensible person, give or take. So it made sense to me. And I just have sort of an intellectual curiosity as far as, every now and then I get an academic itch so I scratch it.
